prompts.characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production transparent sprite atlas for AFTERLIGHT, an original gothic papercraft party fighting game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE only: match its monochrome ivory engraved paper, charcoal ink crosshatching, rough cut white paper border, stacked paper shadows, endearing eerie short-limbed full-body character proportions. NEW characters, not copies: ROW 1 ROOK an armored raven knight with enormous folded-paper gauntlets and a feather cape; ROW 2 BRIAR a masked woodland thorn doll with leaf collar and forked twig antlers; ROW 3 VELLUM a fox-eared ink jester with folded coat and ribbon tail; ROW 4 NIX a small crowned snow-owl with crystalline paper feathers and scarf. EXACT 3 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced cells. Column1 idle standing facing right three-quarter. Column2 dynamic regular attack pose facing right: Rook punch, Briar thorn sweep, Vellum ribbon slash, Nix wing swipe. Column3 signature special active pose facing right: Rook hammer fists to floor; Briar spreading thorn branches; Vellum low ink-blink dash; Nix wings spread launching three ice paper shards. Each row SAME character identity/outfit and scale in all 3cells, consistent visible feet baseline perrow. All twelve fully separate silhouettes entirely within their cells with generous transparent margins; no labels, no grid, no text, no floor, no background. Authentic fibers/hand-inked details, desaturated bone parchment/black/gray only, subtle tiny tarnished bronze details. High-resolution 3:4 portrait atlas. Real transparent alpha background.
prompts.objectives: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for AFTERLIGHT matching supplied monochrome gothic hand-inked papercraft character reference. EXACT 4 columns ×2rows, 8 separate ORIGINAL game props, each centered with generous transparent padding, no labels/no grid/no typography/no background. Top row left→right: ornate destructible target made of concentric torn ivory paper with hanging tiny bell; burlap folded-paper training dummy on weighted black pedestal, cute stitched face; small hostile hollow paper marionette with ink eyeholes and jagged cloak; physical stitched moon-ball black-and-ivory, luminous inner paper star. Bottomrow left→right: ornate gothic lantern banking altar with small bowl; mischievous windup paper bomb with curling wick and clock dial; tall checkpoint pennant shaped like little moon arch mounted to floating stone; giant crowned clockwork paper owl boss torso with exposed luminous heart and huge articulated wings. Detailed crosshatched engraved cutout art, paper thickness visible, black/ivory monochrome with muted bronze highlights, no clean vectors/neon. Consistent front three-quarter game readability. transparent true alpha. Landscape 2:1 atlas.
prompts.frame: Use case: stylized-concept. One original ornate game HUD FRAME for AFTERLIGHT. A wide 3:2 rectangular gothic papercraft picture frame, entirely transparent open empty center (no fill), transparent outside. Match reference monochrome hand-inked paper cutout look: layered ivory card edges, fine black engraving, folded corner ornaments, small raven-feather and moon details at four corners, subtle tarnished bronze inner rule. Thin simple side rails, intricacy concentrated corners, top middle tiny crowned paper star, bottom center small folded diamond. No words, no letters, no icons other than ornamental moons/stars. Frame fills image within 5%outermargin, center 75%width ×70%height fully empty/transparent for game menus. Symmetrical cohesive premium haunted storybook game UI with physical paper thickness and directional shadows, NOT neon/cyberpunk, NOT webcomponent design. High quality transparent sprite asset.
